subject: Uterine cancer
metadata: Uterine cancer or womb cancer is any type of cancer that emerges from tissue of uterus. It can refer to several types of cancer, with cervical cancer (arising from lower portion of uterus) being the most common type worldwide, second most common cancer in women in developing countries. Endometrial cancer (or cancer of inner lining of uterus) is the second most common type, fourth most common cancer in women from developed countries. Risk factors depend on specific type, obesity, older age, human papillomavirus infection add the greatest risk of developing uterine cancer. Early on, there may be no symptoms, irregular vaginal bleeding, pelvic pain or fullness may develop. If caught early, most types of uterine cancer can be cured using surgical or medical methods. When cancer has extended beyond uterine tissue, more advanced treatments including combinations of chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or surgery may be required.

Brookfield boasts that it has Vermonts oldest continually operating library dating back to 1791 . metadata: The Battle of Allia was fought between Senones (one of Gallic tribes which had invaded northern Italy) Romans . Tacitus said that battle took place 15 before Kalends of August, which is 18 July .

metadata: The Farming Game is board game simulating economics of small farm. Published in 1979, it was designed by George Rohrbacher, rancher in Washington State. The Farming Game painfully reflects real-life difficulties of running farm. subject: Frederic North
metadata: Frederic North Frederic Dudley North CMG ( 9 November 1866 \u2013 22 August 1921 ) was English-born public servant sportsman. A descendant of Barons North, he attended Rugby School before emigrating to Western Australia in 1886. North played two first-class matches for Western Australia, was also involved in cricket administration, serving as first secretary of Western Australian Cricket Association ( WACA ) . Outside of cricket, North worked as public servant, filling various roles in Western Australian government, including secretary to Sir John Forrest, first Premier of Western Australia, head Colonial Secretary's Department. He was also Mayor of Cottesloe between 1906 1907 again from 1911 to 1916. North died in Cottesloe from heart attack in 1921, at age of 54.

metadata: The house , built between 1910 1912 for banker James M. Willcox , is two-story , brick limestone , F-shaped house in Italianate-Georgian style . It measures 160 feet in length 32 feet deep at waist . It has slate roof , Doric order limestone cornice , open loggia porches , covered entrance porch supported by Doric order columns . The house was designed by noted architect Howard Van Doren Shaw ( 1869-1926 ) . The property includes formal gardens . Its former carriage house is no longer part of main estate . The original tennis court is now also separate property named Outpost Hill . The Revolutionary encampment is marked by flagpole in circular stone monument at north-western edge of property . The inscription reads , An outpost of George Washingtons Army encamped here thro winter of Valley Forge 1777-1778 .

subject: Ray Milland filmography
object: his work in theatrically released motion pictures
metadata: This is filmography of Welsh actor Ray Milland , containing his work in theatrically released motion pictures as well as his extensive television credits . Milland began his film career in United Kingdom in 1929 after serving three years as guardsman in Royal Household Cavalry , based in London . After appearing in several British films , he came to United States in 1930 where he spent several years playing small supporting roles . Eventually , in 1934 , he became contract player at Paramount Pictures where he established himself as popular star . Milland remained with Paramount for next 21 years . During his time with studio , he developed his persona as debonair leading man , mainly in drawing-room comedies also occasionally in adventure mystery films . In 1945 , Milland won Academy Award for Best Actor for his portrayal of alcoholic writer in The Lost Weekend . From there he continued as leading man well into 1960s , appearing in several film noirs occasionally cast as villain . In 1953 , Milland began working in television as both actor director . He alternated between mediums of film television for remainder of his career . During 1960s 1970s , Milland frequently worked in science fiction horror films .

metadata: John Matthew Rispoli ( 17 August 1582 \u2013 6 April 1639 ) was a major Maltese philosopher of great erudition . He was held in high esteem by Grand Masters of Knights Hospitaller Order , Bishops of Malta , Viceroys of Sicily , cardinals , bishops , inquisitors , common people . Perhaps most eminent Maltese philosopher of Middle Ages , various extant writings of his are witness to his philosophical aptitude dexterity as to his high calibre as philosopher . These qualities were highly appreciated during his lifetime , in Malta as in France Italy . He lived a busy life , both as intellectual as administrator . He was professor of philosopher at various institutions of high education , able preacher , official at various posts within Dominican Order , of which his was member . He was an avid aficionado of music , was talented with playing musical instruments . Though fame of holiness accompanied him in his life , this did not deter Inquisition from suspecting him of heresy , keeping him in its dungeons for fourteen months . When he died , he was given almost state funeral .

The chef de mission was Curt Harnett , appointed in April 2016 after Jean-Luc Brassard , original chef de mission , resigned his position .
